en.html:
Ichijou's swimsuit was a school-style design. She had personally selected it at the shop.

We were not at school. She might have tried something different... but one could say this awkwardness was entirely characteristic of Ichijou. Besides—

en.html:
Kageaki"Besides... that choice..."
Ichijou"...Yes?"
Kageaki"It suits you. Sensible and straightforward."
Ichijou"..."
Ichijou"Y-you think so, sir?"
Sayo"A straight ball, Miss. No intention of pitching one, and still it has gone straight past your bat."
Kanae"...Oh. So the school catalog is the standard by which you judge us?"
Kanae"Nanny. Some assistance, if you please!"
Sayo"At once, Miss. Mr. Minato?"
Kageaki"Yes?"
Sayo"Would a school-style swimsuitschool swimsuit always be your recommendation, then?"
Kageaki"For swimming lessons, yes. I would not call it a universal rule."
Ichijou"L-lessons? I only picked the thing I knew, all right!"
Sayo"Countermeasure has returned to sender, Miss. Postage also we are paying."
Kanae"NANNYYY! You were supposed to be helping me!"
